text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync — we plan to announce v2 latency + cost improvements Tue 8am PT. Need final changelog link, docs URL, and confirm eng freeze by Mon EOD. Also want benchmark narrative and webinar CTA. @Sam can you confirm?
Sam (Eng): Can confirm freeze Mon EOD PST, but we need feature flags and a 10% canary. Draft changelog (internal): https://internal.redwood/changelog/v2-draft — will make public once PR merges.
Maya (Docs): I can publish Monday morning. Please drop final API snippets here or open a tiny PR against docs site. ETA 10:00am PT.
Jules (Eng): Benchmarks are mostly green, uploading raw CSV to GDrive now. Noted one p95 regression on 8k prompts, investigating root cause.
Ava (Marketing): If there's a regression, we should surface it in the announcement as a known tradeoff and offer docs guidance. Also want a short benchmark narrative paragraph for the blog.
Sam (Eng): Canary routing looks fine — we’ll set `rollout: { canary: 0.1 }` and fallback to previous model on errors. Adding the canary policy to prod config now.
LaunchBot: Deployment window scheduled for 2024-04-02T15:00:00Z by @Jules
Ben (Sales): For inbound routing, can Marketing add a demo CTA that routes enterprise leads to Sales queue? I can host a companion webinar the week after.
Ava (Marketing): Yes — CTA should be "Request a dedicated demo" -> https://redwood.ai/demo. We'll also include a webinar sign-up widget on the announcement page.
Maya (Docs): Staging docs link: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/v2/inference — will flip to production after PR merge. Remember to include the guidance for quantized models.
Sam (Eng): API snippets ready, PR #1234 opened with changelog copy in the PR body. @Ava — please review the wording on perf numbers.
Ava (Marketing): Reviewing now. Suggest wording change: use "up to 2.4x lower p95 latency" rather than raw ms when possible. Add one line about quantization caveats.
Jules (Eng): Fixed the KV cache sync that caused the 8k prompt regression. Updated bench sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/bench-v2. Numbers now include canary vs full.
Maya (Docs): Published: https://redwood.ai/docs/v2/inference. Also added changelog anchor to docs and linked the (soon-to-be) public changelog URL.
Ava (Marketing): Final checklist — changelog public? docs live? canary policy set? webinar page up? demo CTA link ready? press asset owner?
Sam (Eng): Changelog public: yes (once PR merges). Docs live: yes. Canary policy applied: yes.
Ben (Sales): Webinar page + signup created, scheduling for Thu 11am PT. I'll send calendar invites to the panel.
Ava (Marketing): Press asset owner = me. I'll draft the press blurb and embargo instructions. Target announce Tue 8am PT. Thanks everyone :tada:
